## About
Harlem & Division Auto Repair is a family owned neighborhood business on N Harlem Ave in Oak Park. Our technicians bring your repair and maintenance needs to one location, whether you drive something new or something vintage.
Any service you're paying your dealership for can be done here. We'd rather build a long, trusting relationship with you through good communication and quality work, and if we become friends along the way, all the better.
We've long supported this neighborhood through sports team sponsorships, scouts programs, religious education programs and local fundraising, including events for Hephzibah, local food pantries and young local musicians.

## Services
- Lube, oil and filter service: Hastings brand oil filter, motor oil, suspension lube, fluid top off, tire pressure check and an inspection of exhaust, steering, shocks, struts, belts, hoses, lights and more. ($34.95 + tax)
- Computer diagnoses (check engine, ABS, SRS): For when your check engine, ABS or SRS light is on. ($149.00)
- Basic vehicle inspection: Our ASE technician road tests your vehicle and does a visual inspection so we can properly estimate the cost of repair or service. ($89.95)
- Vehicle maintenance: A maintenance package for your vehicle, plus any required service. ($135.00 + required service)
- Tire services: Spare tire mounting and tire repair. We inspect the tire inside and out and use a patch and plug system when it's repairable. (Starting at $25)
- Towing and road side assistance: Towing and road side help when your car won't get you here.

## FAQ
Q: Can you do the services my dealership does?
A: Yes. Any service you're paying for at your dealership can be done here.

Q: Do you work on older cars?
A: We do. We maintain and service vehicles of any age, from new to vintage.

Q: What forms of payment do you take?
A: All major credit cards are accepted.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
